arxiv-1903-05208.title: Products of Luzin-type sets with combinatorial properties
arxiv-1903-05208.creator: Piotr Szewczak, Grzegorz Wiśniewski
arxiv-1903-05208.description: Abstract . We construct Luzin-type subsets of the real line in all finite powers Rothberger, with a non-Menger product. To this end, we use a purely combinatorial approach which allows to weaken assumptions used earlier to construct sets with analogous properties. Our assumptions hold, e.g., in the Random model, where already known category theoretic methods fail.

arxiv-2012-14064.title: Comparison of prismatic cohomology and derived de Rham cohomology
arxiv-2012-14064.creator: Shizhang Li, Tong Liu
arxiv-2012-14064.description:
A 2020 arXiv research paper by Shizhang Li, Tong Liu. We establish a comparison isomorphism between prismatic cohomology and derived de Rham cohomology respecting various structures, such as their Frobenius actions and filtrations. As an application, when X X is a proper smooth formal scheme over 𝒪 K \mathcal{O}_{K} with K K being a p p -adic field, we improve Breuil–Caruso’s theory on comparison between torsion crystalline cohomology and torsion étale cohomology. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2106-02924.description: Abstract . We generalize the Cauchy–Davenport theorem to locally compact groups. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 22D05; Secondary 28A75, 11B30 1. Introduction A fundamental result in additive combinatorics is the Cauchy–Davenport inequality [ 3 , 4 ] : Suppose X,Y are nonempty subsets of \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z} for some prime p , then |X+Y|\geq\min\{|X|+|Y|-1,p\}.

arxiv-2110-09025.title: Zeroth-order considerations on an accelerator-based gravitational wave amplifier
arxiv-2110-09025.creator: Velizar Miltchev
arxiv-2110-09025.description: Abstract The operation of an accelerator-based gravitational wave amplifier has been studied, taking into account the interaction between beam and gravitational wave and neglecting all effects related to the emission of - and interaction with electromagnetic radiation. The small-gain operation mode has been considered.

arxiv-2209-03215.title: The internal proper motion kinematics of NGC 346: past formation and future evolution Facilities: HST(ACS) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 )

arxiv-2209-03215.description: Abstract We investigate the internal kinematics of the young star-forming region NGC 346 in the Small Magellanic Cloud. We used two epochs of deep F555W and F814W Hubble Space Telescope ACS observations with an 11-year baseline to determine proper motions, and study the kinematics of different populations, as identified by their color-magnitude diagram and spatial distribution characteristics.

arxiv-2302-11500.title: Virtually free-by-cyclic groups
arxiv-2302-11500.creator: Dawid Kielak, Marco Linton
arxiv-2302-11500.description: Abstract . We obtain a homological characterisation of virtually free-by-cyclic groups among groups that are hyperbolic and virtually compact special. As a consequence, we show that many groups known to be coherent actually possess the stronger property of being virtually free-by-cyclic. In particular, we show that all one-relator groups with torsion are virtually free-by-cyclic, solving a conjecture of Baumslag. 1.

arxiv-2404-04774.title: Application of the Modular Bayesian Approach for Inverse Uncertainty Quantification in Nuclear Thermal-Hydraulics Systems
arxiv-2404-04774.creator: Chen Wang
arxiv-2404-04774.description: Abstract In the framework of BEPU (Best Estimate plus Uncertainty) methodology, the uncertainties involved in the simulations must be quantified to prove that the investigated design is acceptable. The output uncertainties are usually calculated by propagating input uncertainties through the simulation model, which requires knowledge of the model input uncertainties.

arxiv-2503-01212.title: Understanding Dataset Distillation via Spectral Filtering
arxiv-2503-01212.creator: Deyu Bo Songhua Liu Xinchao Wang
arxiv-2503-01212.description: Abstract Dataset distillation (DD) has emerged as a promising approach to compress datasets and speed up model training. However, the underlying connections among various DD methods remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce UniDD, a spectral filtering framework that unifies diverse DD objectives.

arxiv-2506-18703.title: Context Biasing for Pronunciations-Orthography Mismatch in Automatic Speech Recognition
arxiv-2506-18703.creator: Christian Huber, Alexander Waibel
arxiv-2506-18703.description: Abstract Neural sequence-to-sequence systems deliver state-of-the-art performance for automatic speech recognition. When using appropriate modeling units, e.g., byte-pair encoded characters, these systems are in principal open vocabulary systems. In practice, however, they often fail to recognize words not seen during training, e.g., named entities, acronyms, or domain-specific special words.

arxiv-2512-18704.title: A note on the projective representations of p p -solvable and π \pi -separable groups
arxiv-2512-18704.creator: Mariagrazia Bianchi, Nicola Sambonet
arxiv-2512-18704.description: Abstract Following Gluck and Wolf we complete the Itô–Michler’s Theorem for the projective representations of a p p -solvable or π \pi -separable group, and then we relate the projective irreducible modules of such a group with those of its Sylow p p -subroups and Hall π \pi -subgroups.

pmc-10601212.title: Human parechovirus meningitis in children: state of the art
pmc-10601212.creator: Elena Bozzola, Sarah Barni, Chiara Barone, Carlo Federico Perno, Andrea Maggioni, Alberto Villani
pmc-10601212.description: Human Parechovirus is a common cause of infection occurring especially during the first years of life. It may present with a broad spectrum of manifestations, ranging from a pauci-symptomatic infection to a sepsis-like or central nervous system disease. Aim of this study is to explore the knowledge on Parechovirus meningitis.

pmc-10859413.title: Aloe-emodin exhibits growth-suppressive effects on androgen-independent human prostate cancer DU145 cells via inhibiting the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway: an in vitro and in silico study
pmc-10859413.creator: Talib Hussain, Ahmed Alafnan, Ibrahim Abdullah Almazni, Nawal Helmi, Afrasim Moin, Hanadi M. Baeissa, Amir Mahgoub Awadelkareem, AbdElmoneim O. Elkhalifa, Tahani Bakhsh, Abdulrahman Alzahrani, Rashed Mohammed Alghamdi, Mohammad Khalid, Rohit Kumar Tiwari, Syed Mohd Danish Rizvi
pmc-10859413.description: At the molecular level, several developmental signaling pathways, such as Wnt/β-catenin, have been associated with the initiation and subsequent progression of prostate carcinomas. The present report elucidated the anti-cancerous attributes of an anthraquinone, aloe-emodin (AE), against androgen-independent human prostate cancer DU145 cells.

pmc-11487244.title: Plasma C-peptide mammographic features and risk of breast cancer
pmc-11487244.creator: Shadi Azam, Cheng Peng, Bernard A. Rosner, Marcus D. Goncalves, Erica Phillips, Heather Eliassen, John Heine, Susan E. Hankinson, Rulla M. Tamimi
pmc-11487244.description: Our study in the Nurses’ Health Study (NHS) and NHS2, a nested case-control study with 1260 cases and 2221 controls, investigated the association between C-peptide levels, mammographic density (MD) parameters, V (a measure of gray scale variation), and breast cancer (BC) risk. We also examined how C-peptide and BC risk vary across quartiles of mammographic features.

pmc-12399616.title: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder in spontaneously hypertensive rat strain SHR/NCrl is associated with specific expression of uncoupling proteins, glucose transporter 1 and BACE1
pmc-12399616.creator: Tsunehisa Sato, Rolf Schreckenberg, Klaus-Dieter Schlüter
pmc-12399616.description: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is the most prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder worldwide. To improve treatment strategies against ADHD a better understanding of underlying pathophysiology is required. Spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHR) from the strain SHR/NCrl are a suitable rodent model of ADHD.

pmc-12564975.title: Quality of Life in Adults with Congenital Heart Disease: Insights from a Tertiary Centre
pmc-12564975.creator: Polona Kacar, Melita Flander, Katja Prokselj, Gian Luigi Nicolosi
pmc-12564975.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objective: As the survival of individuals born with congenital heart disease (CHD) improves into adulthood, the focus has shifted from traditional clinical outcomes to patient-reported outcome measures that better reflect the impact of the disease on daily life. Our aim was to assess the quality of life (QoL) of adult patients with congenital heart disease (ACHD) followed in a tertiary centre and to evaluate the parameters that influence QoL in this population.

pmc-13002771.title: T2-FLAIR mismatch sign in nonenhancing astrocytoma, IDH-mutant: impact of tumor area on diagnostic sensitivity
pmc-13002771.creator: Iori Ozono, Fumiyuki Yamasaki, Shumpei Onishi, Ushio Yonezawa, Akira Taguchi, Yusuke Takeishi, Novita Ikbar Khairunnisa, Vishwa Jeet Amatya, Yukio Takeshima, Nobutaka Horie
pmc-13002771.description: PurposeThe T2-fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR) mismatch sign is a highly specific imaging biomarker of astrocytoma, IDH-mutant; however, its clinical utility is limited by its low sensitivity. This study aimed to investigate factors contributing to false-negative findings, focusing on the impact of tumor area and quantitative thresholds used for diagnosis.MethodsThis retrospective, single-institution study included 38 patients with pathologically confirmed, nonenhancing astrocytoma.

pmc-13264401.title: US Retina Specialists’ Preferences for Geographic Atrophy Treatment
pmc-13264401.creator: Karl Csaky, Anthony M Pepio, Caitlin Thomas, Bennett Levitan, Seema Garg, Nguyet Tran, Ilan Irony, Nicolas Krucien, Anastasia Doldos, Jennifer A Whitty
pmc-13264401.description: PurposeTwo complement inhibitors are US-approved for geographic atrophy (GA) and other treatments are in development. We present the first quantitative assessment of retina specialists’ (RS) preferences for GA treatment. We explored how GA treatment characteristics affect RS’ preferences, the trade-offs RS are willing to make between them, and whether this varies across patient profiles.

pmc-13611962.title: Functional Evaluation of Neutralizing Antibodies Against Foot-and-Mouth Disease Virus Serotype O Using a Luciferase-Based Surrogate Neutralization Assay
pmc-13611962.creator: Hyejin Kim, Dong-Wan Kim, Yeonrae Chae, Yerin Kim, Giyoun Cho, Ji-Hyeon Hwang, Yoon-Hee Lee, Jong-Hyeon Park, Sung-Han Park
pmc-13611962.description: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a highly contagious viral disease that seriously threatens livestock health. Protective immunity induced by vaccination is primarily associated with the generation of neutralizing antibodies; however, conventional virus neutralization tests are time-consuming and require the handling of live virus, limiting their suitability for rapid and repeated evaluation in routine settings.
